name: Rupadiya–Tikapur National Highway
significance: NH 730H is a branch of NH 730. In the national highway numbering used since 2010, a letter after the number marks a spur or link off the main route — this one runs Rupadiya to Tikapur, and it meets NH 730 along the way.

relatedRoads.label: NH 730 — the highway this branch takes its number from, running Pilibhit to Tamkuhi Raj

sources.title: NHAI — National Highways Authority of India
